gather.answer:
### What the evidence shows

data-transfer-standard: “IT keeps this table current and adds a service before it is used.”

encryption-check-record: “Of 30 emails with confidential attachments, all had the attachment encrypted.”

### What is missing

Nothing is missing.

requirements.reason: The standard lists each network service with what it carries.

citations.quote: IT keeps this table current and adds a service before it is used.

requirements.reason: Channels are set per classification, and the encryption check found every sampled confidential email attachment encrypted.

citations.quote: Confidential information goes only through the file exchange, or by email in an encrypted attachment with the password sent another way.
Of 30 emails with confidential attachments, all had the attachment encrypted.

requirements.reason: Transfers are protected per service, and the encryption check found each internet-facing service passing a scan.

citations.quote: Internet line | Everything above, plus browsing | Firewall, only the ports these services need
An outside scan of every internet-facing service on 22 September 2026:

requirements.reason: Senders check addresses and shares go to one named person, and the encryption check's sample of shares bears this out.

citations.quote: The file exchange sends each share to one named person and ends it after 14 days.
A sample of 50 shares on the file exchange in September: each went to one named person and ended after 14 days at the latest.

requirements.reason: Connections are encrypted and confidential files encrypted too, and the encryption check found both in place.

citations.quote: Email | Day-to-day business mail | TLS between mail servers; confidential content only in encrypted attachments
Of 30 emails with confidential attachments, all had the attachment encrypted.

requirements.reason: Remote access is only through the VPN with a second factor, and the encryption check found every VPN account using one.

citations.quote: Remote access to our network is possible only through the VPN, with a personal account and a second factor.
Every VPN account in use has a second factor.

requirements.reason: Everything leaving the network is encrypted in transit, and the encryption check found outgoing mail and the file exchange using TLS.

citations.quote: All information that leaves our network is encrypted in transit at least by the connection; confidential information is also encrypted as a file.
Mail gateway | TLS 1.2 and 1.3 | Passed; 99.6 percent of outgoing mail in September left over TLS
